name: OAUTH_LANE_KEEPALIVE_RATE_LIMIT_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: OAUTH_LANE_KEEPALIVE_RATE_LIMIT_20261107 — oauth-lane-keepalive failed 54 runs in a row
(exit 1, status failed, ok_at 2026-11-06T00:00:30Z) and every one of those alerts ended with
'fix: hermes auth add openai-codex --type oauth'. That command is an operator-only credential
operation, and it was aimed at the wrong cause: the proxy's own /health said authenticated=true,
token_expired=false, serving=false, last_upstream.state=rate_limited. The free Codex quota was
exhausted upstream — a wait, not a logout. A free-OAuth lane that is rate limited is now classified
rate_limited (vs auth / other), the alert for it says the quota heals on its own and explicitly
says NOT to re-login, and the kind is recorded in the status file and the lane receipt so a long
streak can be read without guessing. The dry run also stops trusting a 200 from /health: it passes
the proxy's serving/last_upstream through lib.oauth_lane_status and reports a rate-limited lane
without spending a generate. Exit stays 1 — the lane really is unusable; only the advice changes.
Hermetic: fake probes and fake health snapshots, no network, no DB, no credential.
